title: Open-sourcing my NSE F&O data collection pipeline — OI, option chains with Greeks, global cues, EOD (37 symbols, parquet)
author: Chennai_data_guy
selftext:
I've been building an options trading system and realized the data collection piece alone is useful enough to share. Half the battle in algo trading is getting clean, consistent data — so here it is.

\*\*Why start collecting now?\*\*

This is \*\*not a historical data source\*\* — it's a forward-looking data collection pipeline. It starts collecting from the day you set it up. The earlier you start, the more data you'll have when you actually need it. If you're planning to build ML models, backtest OI-based strategies, or study option Greeks behavior — having 3-6 months of clean 15-min OI + chain data is gold, and nobody sells this granularity for free. Future you will thank present you for starting the collection today.

\*\*What it does:\*\*

Automated pipeline that collects NSE F&O data throughout the trading day and saves everything as parquet files:

\* \*\*OI snapshots\*\* every 15 min (9:20-15:29) — 26 snapshots/day for all 37 symbols. PCR, max OI strikes, ATM bid/ask spreads, OI change signals
\* \*\*Full option chain\*\* every 15 min — every strike, both CE/PE: OI, volume, LTP, bid, ask, IV, delta, theta, gamma, vega
\* \*\*CAS closing prices\*\* at 15:42 — divergence from continuous close
\* \*\*Pre-market global cues\*\* — S&P 500, NASDAQ, crude, gold, USDINR, DXY, VIX, Hang Seng, Nikkei
\* \*\*EOD data\*\* — 5-min candles (37 symbols), sector indices, FII/DII flows, VIX intraday, futures basis, market breadth
\* \*\*Holiday detection\*\* — automatically skips weekday NSE holidays (fetches holiday list from API)

\*\*Symbols:\*\* NIFTY, BANKNIFTY + 35 F&O stocks (RELIANCE, TCS, HDFCBANK, INFY, etc.)

\*\*Prerequisites:\*\*

\* \*\*Upstox account\*\* with a registered developer app (free) — \[https://account.upstox.com/developer/apps\](https://account.upstox.com/developer/apps)
\* \*\*Analytics token\*\* — generate from the developer console. Valid for 1 year, no daily OAuth refresh needed
\* \*\*Python 3.10+\*\* with pip
\* \*\*Dependencies:\*\* pandas, pyarrow, requests, python-dotenv, yfinance, numpy — all in requirements.txt

\*\*Token renewal:\*\* The analytics token expires after 1 year. Set a calendar reminder to regenerate it from the Upstox developer console and update your \`.env\` file. If running on a VPS, SSH in and update \`.env\` there too.

\*\*What makes it useful:\*\*

\* \*\*No hardcoded ISINs or lot sizes\*\* — instrument keys resolved via Symbol Search API, lot sizes fetched from \`/option/contract\`. Add a stock name to the config list and it just works
\* \*\*Parquet format\*\* — load directly into pandas/polars for ML or analysis
\* \*\*VPS deployment guide\*\* — Oracle Cloud free tier setup included. Runs on cron, no manual start, \\\~10 MB/day storage
\* Sample data included so you can see the output before setting anything up

\*\*What it does NOT do:\*\* No order placement, no trading logic, no strategy code. Pure data collection.

\*\*Adding your own symbols\*\* is one line — just add the NSE trading symbol to the \`STOCKS\` list in config.py. The collector handles key resolution and lot sizes automatically.

\*\*Quick start:\*\*

    git clone https://github.com/BarathGB007/nse-options-data-collector.git
    cd nse-options-data-collector
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    cp .env.example .env   # paste your Upstox analytics token
    python examples/quick\_start.py
    

\*\*GitHub:\*\* \[https://github.com/BarathGB007/nse-options-data-collector\](https://github.com/BarathGB007/nse-options-data-collector)

If you're building anything with NSE options data — backtesting, ML models, OI analysis — this should save you a few weekends. MIT licensed, use it however you want.

Happy to answer questions about the data format or Upstox API quirks.
